mapper.select: SELECT FROM platform_replay WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM platform_replay WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM platform_replay WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id>#{after} ORDER BY job_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM platform_replay WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status IN ('RUNNING','PAUSED')
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_replay SET status=#{j.status},cursor_created_at=#{j.cursorCreatedAt},cursor_event_id=#{j.cursorEventId},examined=#{j.examined},executed=#{j.executed}, already_processed=#{j.alreadyProcessed},failed=#{j.failed},last_error=#{j.lastError},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id=#{j.jobId} AND version=#{j.version}
UPDATE platform_replay SET status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id=#{id} AND version=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM platform_replay WHERE status='RUNNING' AND tenant_id>#{after} ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT job_id FROM platform_replay WHERE status='RUNNING' AND tenant_id=#{tenant} ORDER BY created_at,job_id LIMIT 1

SELECT event_id,created_at FROM platform_event FORCE INDEX(ix_event_replay) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='DELIVERED' AND created_at>=#{j.fromAt} AND created_at<#{j.toAt} AND AND (created_at>#{j.cursorCreatedAt} OR (created_at=#{j.cursorCreatedAt} AND event_id>#{j.cursorEventId})) ORDER BY created_at,event_id LIMIT 1

SELECT event_id,tenant_id,event_type,aggregate_id,aggregate_version,payload_json,created_at,attempts,transient_attempts FROM platform_event WHERE event_id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='DELIVERED' FOR SHARE

SELECT e.event_type,COUNT(*) events,COALESCE(SUM(i.consumer_id IS NOT NULL),0) processed FROM (SELECT event_id,event_type FROM platform_event FORCE INDEX(ix_event_replay) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='DELIVERED' AND created_at>=#{from} AND created_at<#{to} AND ORDER BY created_at,event_id LIMIT #{cap}) e LEFT JOIN platform_inbox i ON i.consumer_id=#{consumer} AND i.event_id=e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_type ORDER BY e.event_type
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM platform_event FORCE INDEX(ix_event_delivery) WHERE status='PENDING' AND available_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND LIMIT #{cap}) d

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status='RUNNING'),0) running,MIN(IF(status='RUNNING',created_at,NULL)) oldest_running,COALESCE(SUM(status='FAILED'),0) failed FROM platform_replay WHERE status IN ('RUNNING','FAILED')
SELECT source_json FROM employee_runtime_replay_source WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id=#{id}
SELECT source_json FROM employee_runtime_replay_source WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
